name: Kyuuteigaka Marize no Yuuutsu
original_name: 宮廷画家マリーゼの憂鬱
source:
Not knowing what had befallen the Queen, 
court painter Marize arrived to draft her portrait. 
She saw Her Highness being r*ped before her eyes, 
and was instructed to paint that lurid scene. 
Once her task was completed, Marize was violated too. 
Tentacles assailed her innocence. The queen watched. 
Court painter Marize's melancholy days had begun. 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE171112.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
不知道女王发生了什么事，
宫廷画家玛丽兹前来绘制她的肖像。
她亲眼目睹殿下被人强奸，
并被指示画出那个可怕的场景。
任务完成后，玛莉丝也受到了侵犯。
触手侵犯了她的纯真。女王注视着。
宫廷画家玛丽兹的忧郁日子开始了。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE171112.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
